skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Applies [Energy Pressure] to the 3 enemies with the highest ATK, lasting 2 turns. [Energy Pressure]: When dealing DMG to HP or [Specialized HP], triggers 1 instance of [Energy Conversion] on the affected enemy unit (reduces the DMG taken and converts it into a shield).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Grants self 20% [Enrage] and [Armor Break]. Deals 7000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 60% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Applies [Energy Pressure] to all enemies, lasting 2 turns. [Energy Pressure]: When dealing DMG to HP or [Specialized HP], triggers 1 instance of [Energy Conversion] on the affected enemy unit (reduces the DMG taken and converts it into a shield).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. For the first 4 turns, the ally with the highest ATK spends 0 Energy when using their Ultimate.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. For the first 6 turns, the ally with the highest ATK spends 0 Energy when using their Ultimate.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. For the first 8 turns, the ally with the highest ATK spends 0 Energy when using their Ultimate.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Grants allied [Hero / Martial Artist] units [Energy Conversion]. Self gains 2.5× the effect of allies’ [Energy Conversion] and can trigger [Energy Conversion] without requiring [Energy Pressure]. [Energy Conversion]: When an enemy affected by [Energy Pressure] deals DMG to the unit, that DMG is reduced%, and 20% of the original DMG value is converted into [Energy Shield].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Grants allied [Hero / Martial Artist] units [Energy Conversion]. Self gains 2.5× the effect of allies’ [Energy Conversion] and can trigger [Energy Conversion] without requiring [Energy Pressure]. At battle start, inflicts [Energy Pressure] on all enemies for 1 turn. [Energy Conversion]: When an enemy affected by [Energy Pressure] deals DMG to the unit, that DMG is reduced by 30%, and 30% of the original DMG value is converted into [Energy Shield].

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
When an enemy carrying [Energy Suppression] damages the carrier, the damage is reduced by 20% and the reduction is converted into energy.
Reduces damage taken from critical hits by a certain percentage.
The shield type converts its cumulative value into damage reduction, is limited to a multiple of the unit's maximum Health, and cannot be used with Resurrection.
Reduces all non-critical damage (usually to 1). Cannot survive and avoid Agility.
The PvP tier's unique health bar stacks on top of regular health, must also be depleted, and can be restored independently.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
While attacking, ignore the enemy's 30% Damage Immunity and Unique Defense to allow the attack to penetrate their shield.
Attack buff increases unit damage, often accompanied by [Shield Break].
The absorption barrier, usually created from transmogrified damage, absorbs damage before health is affected.
When dealing damage to health, forces the target to activate Energy Conversion, reducing the damage they deal and choking their mana source.
